title: Completion compatibility of the lift
statement: Let X be Noetherian, J a quasi-coherent ideal, and a:F→H, a′:F′→H coherent arrows with power-torsion kernel and cokernel for a′. Given θ:F^→F′^ with θ≫a′^=a^, choose n such that ker(a′)→F′/J^(n+1)F′ is monomorphic. In P=F×_H F′ let E be the kernel of p₂≫q′−p₁≫q≫θ_n, with q,q′ the quotient projections. The first projection p:E→F is an isomorphism. For the explicitly constructed g=p⁻¹≫q₂, both g≫a′=a and completion.map(g)=θ hold. The completion functor and quotient systems are those of [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module].

proof.text: Define the finite graph as the kernel of the residual on the pullback F×_H F′. Its first projection is epi by the finite-graph surjectivity lemma.

If a map into the graph has zero first projection, its second projection factors through ker(a′). The graph condition kills its composite with the separating quotient, hence it is zero. Pullback extensionality and monomorphy of the kernel inclusion kill the original map, proving the first projection mono. In the abelian module category it is therefore an isomorphism. Define g using its uniquely determined inverse.

The pullback condition, composed with the inverse first projection, gives g≫a′=a. The kernel condition similarly gives equality with θ at level n+1 after cancelling the source quotient epimorphism. Functoriality gives agreement after completion(a′); finite-level torsion detection gives equality of the full completed maps.

lean.statement:
theorem torsionControlled_completion_hom_lift_constructed
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    {H F F' : CoherentModules X} (a : F ⟶ H) (a' : F' ⟶ H)
    (ha' : ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (kernel a'.hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (cokernel a'.hom)))
    (θ : (completion X J).obj F ⟶ (completion X J).obj F')
    (hθ : θ ≫ (completion X J).map a' = (completion X J).map a)
    (n : ℕ) (hsep : Mono (kernel.ι a'.hom ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F'.obj)) :
    torsionControlledCompletionHomLift J a a' ha' θ hθ n hsep ≫ a' = a ∧
      (completion X J).map
        (torsionControlledCompletionHomLift J a a' ha' θ hθ n hsep) = θ
